name: Nebraska
summary: Statutes and Constitution: nebraskalegislature.gov serves one constructible page per section (statutes.php?statute=25-207; articles.php?article=I-3) that fetch_doc.py reads (WebFetch is gated for built URLs); the printed Reissue volumes and Supplements are free PDFs, and Justia 2025 is the constructible tier-2 fallback. Court rules: nebraskajudicial.gov per-rule pages and whole-article print exports, index-anchored. Case law: the Nebraska Appellate Courts Online Library serves advance-sheet PDFs with official Neb./Neb. App. pagination, located by a plain-GET search on docket or cite; further-review dispositions are in per-volume PFR lists. The Administrative Code site (rules.nebraska.gov) is JavaScript-only with a 401 API, so Cornell LII is the only readable text; Nebraska has no register.

citation_map.notes: Nebraska style: 'Name, 321 Neb. 841, ___ N.W.3d ___ (2026)'; statutes cite the print volume, e.g. 'Neb. Rev. Stat. § 25-207 (Reissue 2016)' or '(Cum. Supp. 2024)' / '(Supp. 2025)' - the volume tag is not part of the URL. Nebraska courts write '(Neb. App. 2021)' while Bluebook uses '(Neb. Ct. App. 2021)'; both match. Court of Appeals memorandum opinions are 'not designated for permanent publication' and cite only as § 2-102(E) allows. Court rules: 'Neb. Ct. R.' plus an optional set tag (Pldg., App. P., Disc., of Prof. Cond.) and '§ c-nnnn'; former pleading rule N = § 6-11NN. Evidence rules are statutes: Neb. Evid. R. N = Neb. Rev. Stat. § 27-N. 'NAC' alone is also Nevada's code: the Nebraska pattern requires the title number before 'NAC' and a hyphenated chapter-section ('92 NAC 51-003'). Bare '§ 25-207', bare S-/A- docket numbers and bare 'further review denied' (Iowa also uses 'further review') are context_required. A '§§ a to b' range is two sections: take the first. CourtListener ids from memory, unverified. The bare-section statute pattern (context_required) refuses '§ c-nnnn of the Nebraska Court Rules/Rules of Professional Conduct'; a 'Neb. Ct. R. … § 2-102' cite can still also hit it, so prefer the Court Rules match whenever 'Neb. Ct. R.' precedes the section. Legislature 'Source' lines write 'Neb. Const. art I, sec. 3'; 'sec.' is accepted.

sources.title: Nebraska Appellate Courts Online Library (advance-sheet opinions, bound volumes, minutes lists)
sources.publisher: Nebraska Supreme Court Reporter of Decisions (hosted by Nebraska.gov)
sources.official_status_evidence: Library page: the printed bound volumes contain the final, official opinions; scanned volumes online are unofficial copies. Advance-sheet PDFs carry official Neb./Neb. App. pagination ('Cite as 321 Neb. 841').
sources.coverage: Supreme Court published opinions in advance-sheet form (Neb. Reports vol. 275 ff. as advance sheets; current vol. 322) and scanned bound volumes Neb. Reports vol. 1 (1871) - 274 (2012); Court of Appeals published opinions (Neb. App. advance sheets, current vol. 34) and bound Neb. App. vol. 1 (1994) - 15 (2011); per-volume Memo / DWO / PFR minutes lists. Released Fridays 8 a.m. (Supreme Court) and Tuesdays 8 a.m. (Court of Appeals).

access.pattern_rules: {query} = docket number (S-25-209, A-25-197) or citation ('321 Neb. 841', URL-encoded). The site's JavaScript POSTs this form, but a plain GET works and returns an HTML table: volume, caption, filed date, docket, 'NNN Neb. NNN' cite, link /viewAdvanced?docId=N000NNNNPUB (same PDF as /viewOpinion?docId=). Full-text search also matches older volumes that mention the term. Listings: /supreme and /appeals (25 per page, ?offset=&max=). The result page also lists many unlabeled viewVolume links (old bound volumes mentioning the term): filter with fetch_doc.py links <search URL> 'viewAdvanced|viewOpinion' --regex.

automation.notes: viewOpinion PDFs (links from nebraskajudicial.gov pages) hit the WebFetch provenance gate twice; fetch_doc.py reads them in full. Long opinions exceed WebFetch's window anyway (S-25-209: 102,805 chars). PDFs carry a library header (download timestamp) on page 1.

hazards: docId is opaque: locate via GET search or listing
advance-sheet N.W.3d cite blank ('___ N.W.3d ___') until published
full-text search returns unrelated older volumes mentioning the term
scanned bound volumes are OCR of whole volumes, split in two parts
docket search results are cluttered with viewVolume hits; filter for viewAdvanced/viewOpinion
